examples.storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

examples.arabic: ديما، كل الجيران بيحبوا أولادنا وبيقولوا إنهم أحسن أصحاب في الحي بتاعنا.
examples.english: Always, all the neighbors love our children and say that they are the best friends in our neighborhood.
examples.transliteration: Dayman, kol el giran bey7ebbu awladna w bey2oolo ennohom a7san as7ab fel 7ayy beta3na.

examples.arabic: احنا هنقضي وقت حلو مع العيلة والاصحاب
examples.english: We will spend good time with family and friends.
examples.transliteration: Eḥna hanqaḍḍī waʾt ḥelw maʕ el-ʕēla wel-aṣḥāb.

examples.arabic: بعدين قعدوا يتكلموا ويشربوا عصير ويستنوا باقي الأصحاب
examples.english: Then they sat talking, drinking juice, and waiting for the rest of the friends.
examples.transliteration: Ba'deen qa'adu yetkallemu we yeshrabu 'aseer we yestannu ba'i el-aṣḥab.

examples.english: And we will invite the family and friends
